description: This file defines the DynamoDBClusteringOptions class, which specifies configuration options for DynamoDB clustering in Orleans. It inherits from DynamoDBClientOptions and includes properties for capacity units, throughput usage, table creation, update policies, and table name.

classes.name: DynamoDBClusteringOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for DynamoDB clustering, including capacity units, throughput settings, and table naming.

methods.name: DynamoDBClusteringOptions
methods.description: Constructor for initializing default values for DynamoDB clustering options.
